description:
Ethan Parker arrives in New York with little money, too much ambition, and an opportunity that could change his life: an internship at Monroe Advertising Group, one of Manhattan's most prestigious agencies.
But surviving the job will only be the beginning.
A brilliant boss, demanding and dangerously hard to ignore. A coworker who gets a little too close between jokes and late nights at work. A sophisticated executive who turns every conversation into a power game. And another intern whose friendship might stop being innocent much sooner than expected.
Between endless meetings, corporate parties, glances that linger too long, and nights when professional boundaries start to blur, Ethan will have to decide how much he's willing to risk.
Make choices, solve visual puzzles, discover unlockables, and get swept up in a story of ambition, temptation, chemistry, and romance in the competitive heart of Manhattan.
At Monroe, one bad decision can cost you your career.
But resisting certain temptations can be even harder.
How far would you cross the line to get everything you want?
